name: dsh-obsidian-math
description: Obsidian side-panel math memory agent for DeepSeek Harness: minimal file tools, layered long-term memory, idea memo with proactive review reminders. Ships as both a dsh plugin and an Obsidian community plugin.

scripts.test: node --check dsh/install.mjs && node --check main.js && node -e "import('./dsh/preset/obsidian-memory.mjs').then(m=>console.log('preset ok:', m.name))" && node scripts/test-installer.mjs
